title: Some heterocyclic compound formation under hydrothermal conditions: implications for prebiotic chemistry
abstract: Abstract                                        The hydrothermal system is considered to be one of the most possible environments for the origin of life. Here we report a hydrothermal reaction from phenol and alanine to four important heterocyclic compounds, 2,3-dihydrobenzofuran (                     1                     ), indoline (                     2                     ), indole (                     3                     ) and 2-methyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydro­quinoline (                     4                     ). This reaction suggests a prebiotic route to synthesize the heterocyclic compounds which could be precursors for the chemical evolution of life.
